title: 36 Hours in Durham, N.C.
abstract: The North Carolina city’s evolution from a faded tobacco town to a diverse cultural and culinary destination has been years in the making.

title: 36 Hours in Washington, D.C.
abstract: Even in a time of transition, Washington is still a hub of art, history and social-justice leadership, and is home to many of the world’s best free museums.

title: 36 Hours in Acadiana, Louisiana
abstract: Explore Cajun Country, a region where French, Creole, Native American and African traditions come together in a cultural gumbo.

title: 36 Hours in Oaxaca, Mexico
abstract: Make mole, learn printmaking and dance in the streets in this city alive with tradition and creative vigor.

title: 36 Hours in Melbourne, Australia
abstract: Visitors willing to explore the alleyways of this arts- and food-loving city will find gems at every turn.
